items.title: OpenClaw Integrates VirusTotal Scanning to Detect Malicious ClawHub Skills
items.description: OpenClaw (formerly Moltbot and Clawdbot) has announced that it's partnering with Google-owned VirusTotal to scan skills that are being uploaded to ClawHub, its skill marketplace, as part of broader efforts to bolster the security of the agentic ecosystem. "All skills published to ClawHub are now scanned using VirusTotal's threat intelligence, including their new Code Insight capability,"

items.title: LocalGPT – A Secure Local Device Focused AI Assistant Built in Rust
items.description: In an era where AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude dominate cloud infrastructures, exposing user data to remote breaches, a new Rust-based tool called LocalGPT promises a fortress-like alternative. items.title: Microsoft Data Center Power Outage Disrupts Windows 11 Updates and Store Functionality
items.description: Microsoft has confirmed that a significant power outage at one of its West US data centers triggered widespread service disruptions yesterday, leaving thousands of Windows 11 users unable to access the Microsoft Store or complete Windows Updates.
